requirements.quote:
Clients that are able to present a spoofed source address on a packet
   can cause a server to send a Version Negotiation packet
   (Section 17.2.1) to that address.
requirements.condition: A client presents a spoofed source address on a packet that causes Version Negotiation.
requirements.required_behavior: The server's Version Negotiation packet is sent to the packet's presented source address.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject a packet bearing a controlled source address and verify the destination of the resulting Version Negotiation packet.

requirements.quote:
client controls from the resulting datagram.  The first byte of this
   packet is not under client control and the next four bytes are zero,
requirements.condition: A Version Negotiation packet is produced as the resulting datagram.
requirements.required_behavior: The first byte is generated independently of client-controlled connection ID data.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The client controls the first byte of the packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can vary all client-controlled input fields and verify that the first byte cannot be selected through those inputs.

requirements.quote:
client controls from the resulting datagram.  The first byte of this
   packet is not under client control and the next four bytes are zero,
requirements.condition: A Version Negotiation packet is produced as the resulting datagram.
requirements.required_behavior: Bytes two through five are zero.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Any of the four bytes immediately following the first byte is nonzero.
requirements.why_checkable: The four-byte field immediately after the first packet byte can be inspected and compared with zero.

requirements.quote:
packet is not under client control and the next four bytes are zero,
   but the client is able to control up to 512 bytes starting from the
   fifth byte.
requirements.condition: A Version Negotiation packet is generated from a packet of an unknown version with client-selected connection ID fields.
requirements.required_behavior: The client-controlled region is bounded to at most 512 bytes and begins at the fifth byte.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: More than 512 bytes starting from the fifth byte are client-controlled.
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary tests can vary client-selected connection IDs and measure the offset and maximum extent of bytes reflected into the resulting datagram.
